name: kelrys-website
description: Source for kelrys.com — a Hugo blog built with Tailwind CSS v4 and deployed to GitHub Pages.

scripts.build: npm run clean:artifact && npm run tailwind:shim && hugo --gc --minify && npm run search && npm run prune
scripts.build:drafts: npm run clean:artifact && npm run tailwind:shim && hugo --gc --minify --buildDrafts --buildFuture && npm run search && npm run prune
scripts.test:prepare: npm run clean:artifact && npm run tailwind:shim && hugo --gc --minify --buildDrafts --buildFuture --baseURL http://localhost:8081/ && npm run search && npm run prune
